name: Coupon SERP - Paste Brands and Run

parameters.formDescription: Paste one brand per line in this format: Brand|domain|country

parameters.jsCode:
return (function buildVerification($input){
 return $input.all().map(({json:item})=>{
  const brand=item.brand;
  const domain=String(item.domain||"").replace(/^https?:\/\//i,"").replace(/\/.*$/,"");
  const country=item.country, website="https://"+domain;
  const urls=(item.results||[]).map(r=>r.url).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10);
  const slug=brand.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g,"-").replace(/^-|-$/g,"");
  const verificationPrompt=[
   `Verify coupon codes for ${brand} (${country}) on the official merchant site ${website}.`,
   "Paste previously extracted CSV coupon rows below:",
   "brand,country,source_url,coupon_code,status",
   "[PASTE COUPON CSV HERE]",
   "Use only actual extracted codes; deduplicate case-insensitively. Use the merchant's cart and real promo-code input where safely accessible.",
   "verified_valid: code accepted and an actual discount visibly applied.",
   "verified_invalid: official merchant explicitly rejects code.",
   "conditions_not_met: minimum spend, item eligibility, first-order restriction or other condition prevents application.",
   "not_testable: no promo field, inaccessible checkout, blocked access, login/payment required or inconclusive.",
   "Record merchant test URL, visible subtotal, currency, actual discount and evidence. Never guess.",
   "Do not register/login, enter personal or payment details, evade access restrictions, place order or complete purchase.",
   "CSV ONLY with header:",
   "brand,country,coupon_code,verification_status,source_urls,official_test_url,cart_subtotal,currency,discount_applied,evidence",
   "Output one row per unique extracted code; join original source URLs with semicolons.",
   "If zero extracted codes, output header only. Use correct CSV escaping."
  ].join("\n\n");
  const threeStepPrompt=[
   `Complete ALL THREE STEPS IN ORDER for ${brand} (${domain}), country ${country}.`,
   "STEP 1 — COUPON DISCOVERY",
   "Use ONLY supplied URLs below. Audit every URL; do not search Google or invent sources. Extract up to first 10 UNIQUE explicitly displayed non-expired coupon codes PER URL.",
   "Interact with Show/Get/Reveal/Copy buttons, inspect modals/popups and return to coupon page after merchant redirects.",
   "Exclude offers clearly belonging to other merchants. Preserve spelling, punctuation and case of each code. No fake/blank codes.",
   "Do not verify at checkout during Step 1.",
   "Create COUPONS CSV (only observed codes; status=extracted; no-code -> header only) columns:",
   "brand,country,source_url,coupon_code,status",
   "SUPPLIED URLs:",
   ...urls.map((url,i)=>`${i+1}. ${url}`),
   "STEP 2 — OFFICIAL MERCHANT DEALS",
   `Visit ONLY ${website} and its own pages; discover current sale/clearance, shipping/delivery and newsletter/SMS/first-order offers.`,
   "Inspect offer listings beyond the homepage. Include exact merchant source URL and restrictions, if any. Only compare original and discounted prices for the SAME product, stay/dates, or subscription plan.",
   ...(/(^|\.)ski-planet\.com$/i.test(domain.replace(/^www\./i,"")) ? ["For Ski-Planet, check current official promos at https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/promo-ski.php , https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/derniere-minute-ski.php?Order=promo and https://www.ski-planet.com/fr/code-promo-ski.php ; confirm dates and prices live."] : []),
   "Create DEALS CSV using verified offers only; deal_type=sale,shipping,newsletter. Missing offers produce no placeholder rows. Columns:",
   "brand,country,website,deal_type,source_url,deal_text,lowest_sale_price,highest_sale_price,currency,min_discount_percent,max_discount_percent",
   "STEP 3 — OFFICIAL CHECKOUT CODE VERIFICATION",
   "Reuse ALL distinct coupon codes obtained in Step 1 automatically; do not ask to paste them again.",
   `On ${website} or legitimate merchant cart/checkout pages, add a representative eligible item to cart if possible, apply each code in promo-code input. Reset cart/promo state as needed.`,
   "verified_valid ONLY if official store accepts code AND visibly applies a real discount.",
   "verified_invalid ONLY if official store explicitly rejects code.",
   "conditions_not_met for eligibility/minimum spend/new-customer/item exclusions.",
   "not_testable for unavailable code field, inaccessible checkout, blocked access, required login/payment or inconclusive result.",
   "Preserve one row per case-insensitively distinct code. Record official test URL, observed subtotal/currency, applied discount and concrete evidence.",
   "Never register, log in, supply personal/payment details, bypass security checks, place orders or complete purchase.",
   "Create VERIFICATION CSV columns:",
   "brand,country,coupon_code,verification_status,source_urls,official_test_url,cart_subtotal,currency,discount_applied,evidence",
   "If no codes found, verification CSV has header only. Combine source URLs for duplicate codes separated by semicolons.",
   "FINAL OUTPUT — THREE CSV FILES, NOT JSON:",
   `${slug}-coupons.csv`,
   `${slug}-deals.csv`,
   `${slug}-verification.csv`,
   "If files cannot be attached, output three separate, clearly named CSV sections saveable independently. No commentary or invented results. Quote CSV fields with commas, quotes or line breaks properly."
  ].join("\n\n");
  return {json:{...item,verificationPrompt,threeStepPrompt}};
 });
})($input);
